hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pathway also induces reversible quiescence in yeast

hypotheses.result: Confirmed via single-factor analysis and Box-Behnken design

title: Bridging efficiency and heat-generation analysis in perovskite solar cells through integrated opto–electro–thermal modeling
task: Optimize perovskite solar cell efficiency via absorber-layer thickness using opto-electro-thermal modeling
key_results: Half-tandem (CsPbI3/FASnI3) achieves 31.2% PCE with Jsc = 28.17 mA/cm², Voc = 1.32 V; planar CsPbI3 reaches 21.76% PCE at 600 nm thickness; carrier thermalization and non-radiative recombination identified as dominant heat sources
comments: Integrated opto-electro-thermal framework is comprehensive but relies on idealized layer interfaces; experimental validation of predicted efficiency gains and heat dissipation patterns is absent.

model_io.model: Opto-electro-thermal simulation for planar and half-tandem perovskite solar cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing absorber thickness improves light absorption and Jsc up to saturation point
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for planar: CsPbI3 200→600 nm increases Jsc from 14.01 to 18.62 mA/cm²

title: Sn-doped CuO nanostructures as a fast and sensitive miniaturized temperature sensor
task: Develop fast, sensitive temperature sensor using Sn-doped CuO nanostructures
key_results: Sn-doped CuO sensor: temperature coefficient of resistance (TCR) −0.70%/°C, sensitivity −41.93 MΩ/°C; operational range 30–170 °C with fast response and high stability
comments: Tin doping enhances electronic structure and morphology, but transduction mechanism (resistance–temperature relationship) and comparison to commercial sensors or alternative materials lack theoretical justification.

model_io.model: Sn-doped CuO nanostructure temperature sensor with integrated micro-heater

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sn4+ doping modifies CuO electronic structure to increase temperature sensitivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Sn-doped samples show −0.70%/°C TCR vs. pure CuO baseline (not quantified)
